description: neuralese-e2e-v1 on LFM2.5-350M (Pop). Backbone-inherent: backbone_lr 7.5e-7 (the direct stage's evidence-backed LFM rate), LFM's measured base gate_pass in the monitor, the pinned LFM2.5 snapshot; no QAT component yet (the known LFM gap, plans/REVIEW_20261012.md item 4). Fit-only: Pop's 8 GB GPU envelope (memory_gb 7.5, graph_memory_gb 6.9, graph_headroom_gb 0.4), checkpointed layers, auto backward routing. A launch recipe extends this one and binds input_bindings.direct_artifact.
